mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payment_refund WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM payment_refund WHERE refund_no = #{refundNo} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT * FROM payment_refund WHERE source_type = #{sourceType} AND source_id = #{sourceId} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT * FROM payment_refund WHERE provider = #{provider} AND provider_refund_no = #{providerRefundNo} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM payment_refund WHERE transaction_id = #{transactionId} AND status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND deleted = FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_refund SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', provider_refund_no = #{providerRefundNo}, refunded_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, failure_code = NULL, failure_message = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('CREATED', 'PROCESSING') AND deleted = FALSE

UPDATE payment_refund SET status = 'FAILED', failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('CREATED', 'PROCESSING') AND deleted = FALSE

UPDATE payment_refund SET status = 'PROCESSING', provider_refund_no = #{providerRefundNo}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'CREATED' AND deleted = FALSE
